g.text: FinRisk - Risk score calculation (swimlanes, with formulas)
How FinRisk turns raw daily prices into a single risk number per portfolio.
For each holding we pull the last 30 closing prices, convert them to
deviation** sigma (Bessel-corrected, N-1 in the denominator), and that
sigma is the asset's volatility. When we don't have enough history we
fall back to a fixed sigma based on the asset's intrinsic risk level.
classify it with the LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/VERY_HIGH thresholds, and scale it
to a 0-100 score using 0.12 daily sigma as the "100" anchor.
